caption: P@L/5 on 314 natural FoldBench proteins, using k=max(1,floor(L/5)) and L equal to the frozen input sequence length, not the number of resolved residues. Same nine predictors and same archived predictions as the R-precision panel, including AF2, AF3, Boltz-2 and decontaminated sequence-KNN. Ground truth and eligible pairs are unchanged: pyconfind degree >=0.001, resolved residues, separation >=6 for all-range or >=24 for long-range. Structure contacts rank by degree, MarinFold by votes; stable candidate-order ties. Means and 95% protein-bootstrap intervals. The menu exposes both ranges and split/design views. Preprocessing reproduces every archived R-precision score before using its P@L/5 counterpart.
